- `HOME=$(mktemp -d) npm test` — pass: 366 passed, 0 failed, 5 skipped (371 tests)
- `npm pack --dry-run` — pass; assisted CLI, dist, schemas, Soul, and sources included
- `git diff --check` / staged check — pass

Same-pattern check: audited packaged-role lists/flags, terminating-tool registry, Recorder extraction/audit path, package lifecycle assertions, and direct-role surfaces; Navigator is additive and existing role/Recorder tests remain green. Introduced-regression check: full suite and cold-package/Recorder/Reviewer/Collector package tests pass.
